items.title: Maitland-Niles stunner rescues late point for Everton against Manchester United
items.summary: It would be putting it mildly to say Everton’s exhaustive search for a new right-back met an underwhelming response when it concluded with the signing of Ainsley Maitland-Niles on Monday. But there was an overwhelmingly positive reaction to the £4.3m recruit’s Everton debut as his stunning 25-yard strike rescued a point with virtually the final kick of the game against Manchester United. Michael Carrick wiped his face in sheer disbelief after the former Arsenal player, 19 minutes into his first appearance for David Moyes’s side, found Senne Lammens’ top corner to send Hill Dickinson Stadium into raptures at the end of a troubled week. United were on the verge of victory following Benjamin Sesko’s 88th-minute header beyond Jordan Pickford but Everton, indignant and defiant after the shambles of transfer deadline day, twice fought back to preserve their unbeaten start to the season. A slow-burning contest erupted into a wildly entertaining second half. Continue reading...

items.title: Embattled Fifa president Infantino declares intention to stand for re-election
items.summary: Infantino is under pressure to resign after sell-off plan Uefa has led calls for president to quit The Fifa president, Gianni Infantino, has reiterated his desire to stand for re-election next year despite the continuing controversy surrounding his leadership. Infantino refused to answer questions about his future when asked by reporters at the Women’s Under-20 World Cup in Poland on Saturday. The 56-year-old Swiss is under severe pressure to resign after trying to sell stakes in Fifa tournaments, including the World Cup, to private investors. Continue reading...

items.title: Armstrong spurns golden chance to win derby as Birmingham and Wolves draw
items.summary: If only Adam Armstrong, the Wolves striker presented with a golden chance in the 87th minute, had shot into the same corner of the net at the Railway End that his teammate ­Jackson Tchatchoua had located when scoring one of the most ­memorable own goals at the end of the first half, then César Peixoto’s team would surely now be second in the Championship. Instead Armstrong, one of the Football League’s most proven goalscorers, lifted his shot over an open goal from 10 yards when played in by Fer López at the end of this implausibly open derby. Birmingham ultimately deserved to extend their unbeaten start to the league season. Continue reading...

items.title: LIVE: Met brilscore de rust in bij Anderlecht-Genk

Paars-wit ontvangt om 18u30 Racing Genk, dat met zeven punten één punt meer telt dan de Brusselaars. items.title: Zakaria El Ouahdi beleeft debuut in mineur bij HSV Hamburg

items.title: Dennis Ayensa, buteur à nouveau épanoui au Standard : "Je botterai les fesses d'Abid s'il ne court pas"
items.summary: Une nouvelle fois buteur décisif des Rouches et auteur de sa quatrième réalisation de la saison, Dennis Ayensa se sent comme un poisson dans l'eau dans ce Standard new-look. Entre l'éclosion d'Adnane Abid, son rôle personnel, le mercato de Marc Wilmots et son transfert avorté en Turquie, l'attaquant de 29 ans s'est longuement exprimé ce samedi soir, après le succès contre l'Antwerp.

items.title: "Ik wil geen excuses zoeken": dit heeft Kortrijk-coach Michiel Jonckheere te zeggen na nieuwe klap en 0 op 15
items.summary: KV Kortrijk bleef zondag opnieuw met lege handen achter, ondanks een wedstrijd waarin het lange tijd nauwelijks iets weggaf. In de Vlasico tegen Zulte Waregem leek de ploeg van Michiel Jonckheere op weg naar minstens een punt, maar twee late tegendoelpunten maakten er alsnog 0-2 van. De frustratie bij de Kortrijk-coach was achteraf dan ook groot.
